maintainer_note: Community-maintained profile. Portage userland, OpenRC init (init/init-openrc.json). A Gentoo/systemd install works too — the engine detects the running init at runtime; only the installer's target defaults to OpenRC, matching the openrc stage3. Package atoms are given in full category/name form and were validated against the ::gentoo tree; OpenRC service names come from the init scripts the corresponding ebuilds install. Persistent hostname lives in /etc/conf.d/hostname (written by the installer); system.hostname_set only changes the running one, as on Void.

packages.module_search: emerge --search --color=n --nospinner '%^freedomnas-module-' | awk '/^\*  / {{n = $2}} /Latest version available:/ {{v = $NF}} /Description:/ {{sub(/^ *Description: */, ""); print n "\t" v "\t" $0}}'
packages.module_installed: emerge --search --color=n --nospinner '%^freedomnas-module-' | awk '/^\*  / {{n = $2}} /Latest version installed:/ {{v = $NF}} /Description:/ && v != "]" {{sub(/^ *Description: */, ""); print n "\t" v "\t" $0}}'
packages._note_modules: module_search / module_installed: community modules are the packages named freedomnas-module-<id>; one line per package: name<TAB>version<TAB>description. module_search reads the local package index (update_cache refreshes it).

power_button.rule:
# FreedomNAS: a press of the power button shuts the NAS down.
event=button/power.*
action=/bin/sh -c poweroff
